scoring.coding: the transcriber codes each event from the narration and the screenshots using the event and observable columns only, writes the outcomes file, and only then runs the script; the p column is not read while coding

outcome.1: the observable condition is met by the narration or the screenshots
outcome.0: the event's segment is narrated or shown and the condition is not met
outcome.null: the segment is neither narrated nor shown: the event is not scored

brier.formula: mean over scored events of (p - o)^2
references: the constant forecast at the mean p of the scored events
also_reported: per basis, with how often p was on the right side of 0.5

kendall.predicted: ranking.rank (average ranks; a lower rank is a longer segment)
kendall.measured: per segment, the median over its dated instances of the minutes from its first event to its last, read from clocks (resolution one minute)
kendall.ties: measured minutes are rounded to whole minutes; equal means tied
kendall.p: exact one-sided permutation p over the orders of the measured values
kendall.reversal: a pair the weights order stably (not in parameters.rank_ties.unstable_pairs) that is measured the other way by at least 1 minute and 25% of the longer one

sources: the status-bar clock of a screenshot
the foot's 'Recorded HH:MM' of a recorded pair

instances.pair: between two consecutive saves with no reload, lock or break between them
instances.pair-reload: a pair interval that contains a narrated reload
instances.pair-lock: from the unlock to the next save
instances.queue: from the first page after the load toast to the first pair header after Next pair
instances.export: from the tap on Check to the toast 'Copied N picks as JSON'
instances.handback: from the toast to the message in the chat
instances.break: a gap over 10 minutes between two consecutive saves is a break and is not an instance; the lock interval is removed

onsets.B: scored at B=3 as the primary and, as they were registered, at B=2 and B=4; none is chosen after the pass
onsets.hit: a loss (forgot, lost the goal, went back to re-read) is narrated at a moment the transcriber maps, from the chains' step targets and before reading p, to a step within 2 steps of a predicted onset of the same chain
onsets.chance: for each narrated loss, the share of that chain's steps that lie within 2 steps of a predicted onset (5 of 9 in the pair chain at B=3)
onsets.false_alarm: a loss narrated in a chain with no predicted onset at that B

scoring.p02be: the observed rate of events whose steps carry a verifier finding against events whose steps carry none; unregistered frictions (a friction no event describes) and whether their step is silent; false findings (a finding whose step is narrated as smooth)
scoring.owner_leaves: a narration written right after, in their own words (as on 2026-10-03), and screenshots with clock times; nothing else

P-67a1.claim: the chain load, with ordinal weights, orders segments of one task by their duration
falsified_on_this_pass_if: tau-b of the load ranking is 0 or below over the comparable segments that have a measured duration (4 are needed to score)
any pair the weights order stably is measured the other way by at least 1 minute and 25% (kendall.reversals)
tau-b of the step-count baseline is at least that of the load: the weights add nothing over counting steps
P-67a1.limit: the two rankings differ on 2 of 15 comparable pairs, so the third test can only fail or pass on those

P-02be.claim: a chain can pass by omission: the silence of the verifiers does not mean a step is smooth
shown_on_this_pass_if: an unregistered friction sits at a step where no verifier fired (p02be.unregistered_at_a_silent_step above 0)
a finding sits at a step the narration calls smooth (p02be.false_findings above 0)
events at steps with no finding occur at least as often as events at steps with one (p02be: the rate without a finding is not below the rate with one)
falsified_on_this_pass_if: none of the three holds over at least 15 scored events
